cause: Long canvas workers exited with code 137 after substantial resident-memory growth. The exact operating-system termination reason was not captured.
resolution: Periodic GC improved speed but remained insufficient: a later worker also exited 137. The final supervisor uses a fresh process per completed segment, one at a time. All rendering and encoding operations are unchanged; segment continuation is separately proved.
scope: Early memory samples were insufficient to establish full-run safety. Final completion and delivery checks validate the isolated-worker approach for these files; no peak-memory bound or acoustic accuracy is claimed.
finalOutcome: Both full exports completed using isolated segment workers. Each passed strict decoding, every frame timestamp, original AAC and PCM identity, and all 25,186 decoded word states.
